package v1

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/transport/http/admin/v1/handlers"
)

func TestAdminRoutesAreRegisteredWithExplicitRolePolicy(t *testing.T) {
	for _, path := range []string{"/personal-teachers/student-1", "/personal-teachers/student-1/soul"} {
		response := httptest.NewRecorder()
		request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, path, nil)
		NewRouter(&handlers.PersonalTeacherHandler{}).ServeHTTP(response, request)
		require.Equal(t, http.StatusUnauthorized, response.Code)
	}
}
